description: Add unit tests for the server scoring strategies (currently 0% coverage, pure and easily testable per the audit): ChipsStrategy.ts and GrandPrixStrategy.ts, exercising SessionScoringStrategy.applyGameResult and the shared computeSessionRanks tie behavior. ADDITIVE test files only - must NOT require changing the strategies. Independent of FEAT-001/002/003.
steps: Read packages/server/src/scoring/{ChipsStrategy.ts,GrandPrixStrategy.ts,SessionScoringStrategy.ts} to lock in exact contracts. Key facts: applyGameResult(players: Player[], gameLeaderboard: GameLeaderboardEntry[], rawScores: Record<string,number>) returns { sessionScores, sessionLeaderboard }. ChipsStrategy: sessionScores[player.id] = rawScores[player.id] ?? 0 (raw delta passthrough); mode === 'chips'. GrandPrixStrategy: awards placementPoints[entry.rank-1] per gameLeaderboard entry (default table [10,5,3,1,1,1,1,0,0,0]); ranks beyond the table get 0; players not in gameLeaderboard get 0; mode === 'grand-prix'; constructor accepts an optional custom placementPoints array. computeSessionRanks sorts by sessionPoints desc and gives tied players equal rank.

Create packages/server/src/scoring/__tests__/ChipsStrategy.test.ts (server test env; import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest'). Build minimal Player[] fixtures (id, name, and whatever other required Player fields the shared type mandates - read @games-of-chance/shared Player type; construct valid objects). Cover: (1) raw scores pass through directly to sessionScores; (2) a player missing from rawScores gets 0; (3) each entry carries gamesPlayed delta 1; (4) sessionLeaderboard is rank-ordered by points desc; (5) tied players receive equal rank (via computeSessionRanks); (6) mode === 'chips'. Assert concrete numbers.

Create packages/server/src/scoring/__tests__/GrandPrixStrategy.test.ts. Cover: (1) default placement points - rank 1 -> 10, rank 2 -> 5, rank 3 -> 3, rank 4 -> 1, etc., matching DEFAULT_PLACEMENT_POINTS; (2) rawScores are ignored (pass nonzero rawScores and assert sessionScores derive only from gameLeaderboard rank); (3) a rank beyond the table length yields 0; (4) a player present in players[] but absent from gameLeaderboard gets 0; (5) a custom placementPoints array passed to the constructor is used instead of the default; (6) sessionLeaderboard ranks reflect awarded points with ties equal; (7) mode === 'grand-prix'. Assert concrete numbers.

Optionally add a focused test for computeSessionRanks tie behavior (packages/server/src/scoring/__tests__/SessionScoringStrategy.test.ts) if not already exercised: equal sessionPoints -> equal rank; strictly-descending points -> 1,2,3.

If any test seems to require changing a strategy or the shared types to pass, STOP and record in findings - do NOT change source. Run the new tests under the server suite and confirm they pass without disturbing other tests.
acceptance_criteria: packages/server/src/scoring/__tests__/ChipsStrategy.test.ts exists and passes, covering raw-score passthrough, missing-player default 0, gamesPlayed delta, rank ordering, tie ranks, and mode.

packages/server/src/scoring/__tests__/GrandPrixStrategy.test.ts exists and passes, covering default placement points, rawScores ignored, out-of-table rank -> 0, absent-player -> 0, custom placementPoints, tie ranks, and mode.
New scoring tests pass under `unset NODE_OPTIONS && pnpm --filter @games-of-chance/server test`.
No scoring source file (ChipsStrategy.ts, GrandPrixStrategy.ts, SessionScoringStrategy.ts) was modified - additive test files only.
Assertions use concrete expected numbers, not trivially-true checks.
verification: git diff --stat (confirm only new test files added under scoring/__tests__, no scoring source changed)
findings: Added 3 additive test files under packages/server/src/scoring/__tests__/: ChipsStrategy.test.ts (7 tests), GrandPrixStrategy.test.ts (9 tests), SessionScoringStrategy.test.ts (5 tests) covering computeSessionRanks. All 21 new tests pass; `pnpm --filter @games-of-chance/server test scoring` = 51/51 green (includes pre-existing scoring-area tests). No scoring source modified. Player fixtures built as fully-typed objects (id, name, role, connected, connectionId) per @games-of-chance/shared types.ts. GameLeaderboardEntry requires playerId, playerName, score, rank. Server typecheck (tsc --noEmit) exits 0. Note: an untracked client leaderboard test file (packages/client/src/components/game/__tests__/BaseLeaderboard.test.tsx) from the parallel FEAT-003 work was present in the workspace; left untouched and NOT staged.
